prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: C01-ARCH-FORGE-CITY, the Mountain Forge city architectural setting plate in The Oath of the Broken Crown, an opaque landscape catalog scene.
Create ONE finished landscape image at 1672 x 941 if available, approximately 16:9, safe for a centered exact 1664 x 936 crop. Edge-to-edge opaque painting, no panels or borders.
Input roles: Image 1 is the original exact Forge City source cell and defines the LOCATION and ARCHITECTURE. Images 2 and 3 define the approved broad chunky narrative STYLE only; do not copy their tents, flags, medical objects or people.
Scene and identity: a working mountain forge settlement built on several open rocky terraces against a rugged exposed slate-gray cliff face. This is a wide establishment view of an inhabited cliffside INDUSTRIAL CITY, not a cavern-interior closeup of one furnace or an emergency repair event. Preserve the original architectural ensemble: a prominent squat central stone furnace house on a middle terrace, several separate stone-and-timber forge workshops on the upper and side terraces, warm amber-lit arched furnace mouths, dark slate roofs, thick bronze-banded pipes, one or two large dark wheel mechanisms, simple wood hoist towers and cranes, clear stone stairs and short timber walkways linking levels. At the lowest edge, a small wooden bridge crosses a cool narrow stream at the foot of the cliff. Keep the city visually integrated into the cliff ledges, with sparse pine greenery at the outer edges and hints of open mountain air. Buildings and circulation are the main subject.
Ordinary life: a restrained scattering of about eight anonymous compact adult mountain craftspeople and miners, wearing practical brown or muted slate work clothes, simple caps or helmets and aprons. Some carry a tool or push a small ore cart. They are tiny relative to the buildings; none is a named hero or a portrait focus. A few grouped crates and ore tubs are enough. No dramatic confrontation, no collective pledge, no central records table, no heroic figure staging.
Composition: elevated three-quarter wide landscape viewpoint. Show the central middle-level forge building complete, an upper workshop tier behind it, and the descending stair connection and lowest wooden stream bridge together in the central region; broader side wings reveal the additional workshops, lift and cliff. Establish several distinct usable terraces and a readable connected settlement, not a symmetrical palace or an isolated machine. Strong central architectural silhouette remains legible at 256 x 144. The narrow center crop should retain one complete recognizable forge building and vertical city circulation, although the full city's breadth belongs to the landscape.
Style: precisely match the approved camp and hospital style: bold stable dark contours, broad chunky matte fantasy forms, squat wide buildings, oversized simplified structural parts, large clean stone blocks and cel-painted planes. Calm broad rock faces and terrace paving with only a handful of purposeful slab joints. Restrained grouped mechanical detail: large wheels and braces, a few pipe bands, no hundreds of gears, tiny rivets or gritty scratches. Warm ochre/bronze and amber furnace light balanced with cool slate cliffs and muted pine green. Furnace light is localized and modest; daylight still makes architecture readable. No overall orange wash, no smoky obscurity or photoreal noise.
Constraints: retain original exterior cliffside forge-city identity; do not replace it with the already separate underground joint-repair chapter scene, a giant molten basin, lava rivers, an interior hall or a solitary centerpiece machine. No invented readable archive labels or contracts. No new faction emblems, recognizable named character, crown, dragon or military banners. No words, numbers, logo, watermark or frame. Full opaque illustration with restrained clean surfaces.
